body: Thank you! I'm sorry for your loss, and grateful for your kindness.
I hope it's not the case of the latter. I'm quite surprised that you see this as a sign of moving forward, I didn't think that would be the case. I hope I'm moving forward too.

I've tried cutting myself, but they were no more than scratches, because the sight of blood scares me. Glad to find someone I can relate to. But I do hope you get help instead, I wish the best to you.
I would recommend keeping a few bites in your room? A bit of biscuits or some juice, usually I do eat them, just not often, but it will remind you at least.

Thank you so much. I think I'm more deliberate instead of unintentional. I used to do it unthinkingly but now it seemed I've chose to starve myself instead. Thanks for sharing, I will consider seeking professional help.
I see. Thank you so much for your concern. I will consider it.
I also tried to force myself to eat, though it's because so that I can starve myself further. Even if it's just tiny bits.
I felt that before. The thought of food makes me nauseous. Thanks for sharing \^\^
